column1: # REGISTER 4 (PARTIAL) - mutation-proofs.wave7-archetypes.tsv
# Wave-7 proofs for the two guard files that replace the retired PIXEL-EXACT figure gate on
# `archetypes.png` and `screen_worlds.png`: reference-impl/tests/test_archetypes.py and
# reference-impl/tests/test_screen_worlds.py. `tools/regen_figures.py` already names both files as
# what guards those figures instead of their pixels (INVARIANT_GATED["archetypes"],
# INVARIANT_GATED["screen_worlds"]); until this wave neither file asserted the quantities those
# entries cite. Written here and NOT into the shared mutation-proofs.tsv, which other agents are
# filling in the same wave. Merge target: the test_archetypes.py and test_screen_worlds.py rows.
# EVERY CELL BELOW IS FROM EXECUTION, none predicted. The harness for each trial was:
#   1. read the live SUBJECT file into memory   4. restore the file from memory
#   2. apply the edit                           5. compare the restored bytes to the copy AND
#   3. clear every __pycache__ under               re-run `git diff` on the subject, checking its
#      reference-impl/, then run the named          sha is unchanged from before the trial
#      pytest selection                          -- after EVERY trial, 23 of 23, never once at the end
# `__pycache__` is cleared on BOTH sides of every trial because CPython validates a .pyc on
# (mtime-seconds, size): a byte-length-identical mutation applied and reverted inside one second
# has produced a false RED in this repo before.
# No mutation was ever applied to a guard file. Every subject is archetypes.py or screen_worlds.py.
# DENOMINATOR - defect classes proved
#   rows with a mutation that went GREEN -> RED .......... 11  (100%)
#   rows with a decoy that stayed GREEN .................. 11  (100%)
#   IDENTITY: 11 classes == 11 rows -> HOLDS
#   DECORATIVE clauses inside a PROVEN row ............... 1, named in R11's verdict:
#     `assert hi - lo < 30.0` in test_monument_valley_relief_is_guarded_narrowly_not_by_a_floor
#     reads that file's own BANDS table, so no mutation of a SUBJECT module can move it. It is a
#     freeze on the guard's own tolerance, declared here rather than presented as coverage.
#   Trials run: 23 (11 mutations + 11 decoys + 1 rejected decoy candidate, row 8 below).
#   REJECTED DECOY, recorded rather than hidden: `screen_worlds.py:63 talus=0.45 -> 0.47` was
#     tried first as the Monument Valley decoy and went RED (relief 251.498, band [253.4, 280.6]).
#     A 4% talus change really does move the guarded quantity, so it is a mutation, not a decoy;
#     the shipped decoy (the smallest spire, 0.028 -> 0.026) was measured green afterwards.
# WHY THESE GUARDS EXIST, AND THE MEASUREMENT BEHIND EVERY TOLERANCE
#   The pixel gate is unsound across machines: two CI runs on identical numpy 2.4.6 / pillow
#   12.3.0 / CPython 3.11 produced different montages. The mechanism was REPRODUCED here, not
#   inferred. numpy dispatches its transcendental ufunc loops on the CPU's SIMD level, and the
#   loops are not bit-identical; measured over 10007 doubles in [0,1] with NPY_DISABLE_CPU_FEATURES:
#       pow(x,1.4), exp, log1p, tan, arctan  differ, max relative 2.22e-16 = exactly 1 ULP
#       add, mul, sqrt, sin, hypot, sum, mean  bit-identical
#   Running this repo with AVX512 enabled vs disabled reproduces BOTH published CI runs EXACTLY:
#       canyon relief   268.99 / 270.71   (CI reported 269 / 271)
#       canyon pit    5.2169e6 / 4.1597e6 (CI reported 5.22e6 / 4.16e6)
#       badlands relief 260.52 / 258.63   (CI reported 261 / 259)
#       badlands p99     35.278 / 35.236  (CI reported 35.3 / 35.2)
#       Monument Valley relief 258.60 / 267.64  (CI reported 259 / 268)
#   For `canyon` the divergence enters at archetypes.py:83, the `** 1.4` on the trunk profile;
#   erosion_droplet.droplet_erode then amplifies one ULP by ~1e14 because a droplet's steepest-
#   descent step is a DISCRETE choice and a tie flips.
#   So each band was SAMPLED, not chosen: 44 Monte-Carlo trials at n=96 that nudge every
#   noise.fbm/perlin/ridged_mf/worley result and every droplet-erosion input by a random -1/0/+1
#   ULP, plus the two real dispatch regimes = 46 samples per quantity. The 46-sample envelope
#   contains both real regime values for all 96 quantities; a 24-sample envelope did NOT, missing
#   one by 1.9351% of the value. band = [min * 0.98, max * 1.02], rounded outward to 4 significant
#   figures -- the 2% margin IS that measured 1.9351% residual, rounded up.
#   ⚠️ WHAT THE BANDS DO NOT CATCH, stated because it is the honest result: a guard must be green
#   on both runners, so NONE of the 18 quantity-slots that actually differ between the two dispatch
#   regimes is caught by its own band. canyon pit-storage drifts 22.5% inside a +-33.5% band;
#   Monument Valley relief drifts 3.43% inside a +-5.09% band. For the seven droplet-eroded tiles
#   the cross-machine spread IS the noise floor and pit-storage cannot be guarded tightly at all.
#   The other 71 of 96 slots have a measured envelope of ~1e-13% and close to +-2%. Every mutation
#   below was chosen to fall OUTSIDE the derived band, never to be merely larger than the drift.
